name: Mouse movement dynamics
plain: Records cursor paths, speed and acceleration.
meaning: Movement curvature, jitter and click timing separate humans from bots and can identify repeat users. Coalesced events give up to 1000 Hz traces on gaming mice.

limits.headline: Can track how your cursor moves on the page, to tell people from bots
limits.user_action: You move or click the mouse on the page
can: Record cursor paths, speed and how it speeds up
Tell humans from bots by how smooth the movement is
Spot repeat visitors from their movement style
cannot: Follow your cursor outside the page
Follow your hand when the pointer is not over the page
limits.differs: Phones and tablets have no cursor, so touch movement is tracked instead.

story.what_it_is: A script records cursor paths, speed and acceleration to judge if a human is moving the mouse.
story.for_you: You never see it. Real people move a mouse with small wobbles and pauses. A page that records your movement can tell you apart from a bot, and sometimes tell you apart from other people.
story.for_makers: Fraud and bot defense tools use mouse paths as a key signal, like in invisible CAPTCHAs. Marketers use the same data for heat maps that show where people look and click.

use_cases.example: An invisible CAPTCHA like reCAPTCHA v3 scores how human your mouse moves are, so most people never see a puzzle.
A site uses heat maps of mouse movement to see which part of a page people hover over before buying.
A ticket seller blocks scalper bots that move the cursor in perfectly straight lines.
A bank adds mouse habits to its fraud score at login, quietly checking you move like usual.
A browser game catches aim bots that move the cursor in robotic jumps.
An ad system checks that clicks on ads came from natural mouse movement, so advertisers are not charged for bot clicks.
A product team watches session replays of cursor movement to find a confusing button.

risks: Replay tools can see a lot

technical_bounds: No readout of pointer outside window except during drag/capture

value.abuse: Behavioral CAPTCHAs (reCAPTCHA v3, Turnstile, Akamai sensor) and user identification
